description: Lake Dvaipayana. Duryodhana hides underwater using mystical Samadhi (yogic trance). The Pandavas taunt him to emerge for the final mace duel. This map is the lake area before the duel.

tiles.note: The lake. Impassable. Duryodhana is hidden beneath.

tile_overrides.note: Duryodhana hides here using yogic powers.

PANDAVA.note: The five Pandavas and Krishna approach the shore.

KAURAVA.note: Duryodhana emerges from the lake center after taunts.

special_mechanics.taunt_trigger: At turn 3, VNScene: Krishna taunts Duryodhana as a coward. Duryodhana emerges. Transition to map_lake_shore for the actual duel.
